title: LumaGrid Product Launch
audience: product leaders, operators, and AI platform buyers
goal: launch LumaGrid as the premium command layer for verified AI work

story.thesis: AI work becomes valuable when every output can be reviewed, verified, and reused.
arc: Teams have more AI output than they can confidently ship.
The winning product layer is not another chat box, but a verified work system.
LumaGrid turns agent output into launch-ready artifacts with proof built in.

slides.title: The command layer for verified AI work
slides.subtitle: LumaGrid helps teams turn agent runs into polished artifacts, evidence trails, and reusable workflows.
slides.presenterNotes: Open with the shift from AI assistance to AI work systems.

slides.headline: The next AI platform is judged by the quality of its finished work.
slides.subheadline: Teams do not need more raw generations. They need reliable systems that can plan, render, verify, and ship.

proofs.label: Artifacts created

slides.title: LumaGrid packages the whole delivery loop

features.title: Narrative planning
features.description: Every artifact starts from audience, goal, thesis, and a structured arc.

features.title: Visual rendering

features.title: Evidence trail

slides.title: The market is moving from copilots to work systems
